title: South Carolina's 3rd Congressional District Election, 2026
description: South Carolina's 3rd Congressional District covers the western Upstate region including Anderson, Oconee, Pickens, and parts of Greenville and Edgefield counties. Incumbent Republican Rep. Sheri Biggs, first elected in 2024, is seeking her first full term in what is widely considered the state's most conservative district. She faces Democratic nominee Eunice Lehmacher, a licensed counselor and healthcare professional who won a competitive primary, and Libertarian candidate Brian Corriea, a Navy veteran and activist. The race tests whether Biggs can consolidate her freshman incumbency advantage in a heavily Republican seat that has not elected a Democrat to Congress in decades.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found for this specific general election race as of July 2026.

candidates.name: Sheri Biggs
candidates.summary: Sheri Biggs is the incumbent U.S. Representative for South Carolina's 3rd Congressional District, first elected in 2024. A board-certified family nurse practitioner and Lieutenant Colonel in the Air National Guard, she serves on the House Committees on Foreign Affairs, Homeland Security, and Science, Space, and Technology. Her campaign platform emphasizes stopping undocumented immigration, cutting government spending, and serving veterans' needs.

candidates.name: Eunice Lehmacher
candidates.summary: Eunice Lehmacher is a licensed professional counselor and healthcare professional from Clemson, South Carolina, and the Democratic nominee for the 3rd Congressional District. She won a competitive Democratic primary in June 2026 against Ernest Mackins. Lehmacher has over 40 years of experience as a counselor, educator, social worker, and small business owner, and was appointed by Gov. Henry McMaster to serve on the state Mental Health Board for Anderson, Oconee, and Pickens Counties. Her campaign focuses on lowering healthcare, housing, and utility costs, investing in clean energy, and making necessities more affordable.

candidates.name: Brian Corriea
candidates.summary: Brian Corriea is a Libertarian Party candidate for U.S. House in South Carolina's 3rd Congressional District. A U.S. Navy veteran who served nine years, he works as a claims adjuster and is active in the South Carolina Libertarian Party as a political commentator and activist focusing on government spending, sound money, and personal responsibility. He is a homeschool parent and advocates for limited government and individual liberty.

forecast.rationale: No public general-election polling exists for this race, so the forecast relies entirely on district fundamentals. South Carolina's 3rd is described as the state's most conservative district and has not elected a Democrat to Congress in decades. Incumbent Republican Sheri Biggs, first elected in 2024, benefits from freshman incumbency in a heavily Republican seat with a strong Republican voting history. Democratic nominee Eunice Lehmacher is a credible candidate with healthcare and community credentials, but faces severe structural headwinds in a district where the Republican baseline is overwhelming. Libertarian Brian Corriea may draw a small protest vote. Given the district's entrenched Republican lean and incumbency advantage, Republicans have an overwhelming edge (~97% win probability), but confidence is only medium due to the complete absence of race-specific polling data.
